title: Table Module Record Set Pollution
pattern: Carrying untyped, tabular `RecordSet` or row hash map structures throughout business logic layers in place of type-safe objects.
why_bad: It eliminates compiler checks. Typo errors in column name strings (e.g., `"totall_amount"`) lead to quiet runtime bugs, and the domain model's self-documenting type benefits are entirely lost.
detection: Domain logic files performing lookups and mutations on generic string-keyed record structures or tabular maps.
counterexample: Low-level mapping engines or reporting systems where data format is dynamic. Mark as `Context-dependent`.
fix: Map tabular row collections to typed domain structs immediately when leaving the persistence module.
source: *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* by Martin Fowler (p. 271, "Table Module").
